page_note: This page is overwhelmingly cosmological substrate. Two structural units: a continuation describing purification of waters/firmaments/lands (segs 0-24) and a new chapter (#41 'Concerning the Tongue of the seas') opening with apostolic dialogue frame at seg 28 and immediately resuming substrate teaching about the Living Spirit, the King of Glory, and the three wheels. The cosmology is classic Manichaean cosmogony but in its impersonal-systematic mode: gathering kindreds (water-to-water, fire-to-fire, darkness-to-darkness), driving expelled darkness to West/outside-cosmos, the Omophoros bearing the lands. The Illuminator/disciples formula at seg 28 is the only true frame line; the chapter heading (segs 25-27) is editorial section apparatus.
